a80ddefb-bcf7-4582-b0e1-f35d7ca533d3/Eve.en: "Amitabha...<NL>The deeper one's karmic hindrances, the more worldly fame and fortune one must cast aside..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(The greater the selected Reputation's influence and the longer the duration of reduction, the more Prestige will be consumed...)</color>
a80ddefb-bcf7-4582-b0e1-f35d7ca533d3/Eve.cn: “阿弥陀佛……<NL>业障愈深，须得撇弃的名利自然愈多……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>  （所选名誉影响越大、削减的持续时间越久，消耗的威望便越多……）</color>
a80ddefb-bcf7-4582-b0e1-f35d7ca533d3/Eve.ru: "Амитабха...<NL>Чем глубже кармические препятствия человека, тем больше мирской славы и богатства он должен отбросить..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Чем больше Влияние выбранной репутации и чем больше продолжительность снижения, тем больше Престижа будет израсходовано...)</color>

9ce502dc-84d9-4983-b29a-6421735e7675/Eve.en: "Whether <color=#yellow>Xiangshu</color> is considered righteous or evil, the Jade-Maiden Sect doesn't particularly mind.<NL>However, you, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>, have demonstrated the wisdom to acquire knowledge from various sects. Perhaps, in the future, you could assist us in unraveling the mysteries of Egarim..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
9ce502dc-84d9-4983-b29a-6421735e7675/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「相枢」</color>是好是坏，我璇女派全不在意！<NL>不过你<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>博采众家之长，或许将来可助我派解开‘一明珏’玉刻的奥秘……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

e891fb12-df86-47a4-bef6-8bfe69791e60/Eve.en: "Have more patience, please, and hear me out.<NL>Do you truly intend to be a Xiake of benevolence in this world?"<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> spoke at length of such matters, recounting all they had seen...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After listening to <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s account of the mundane world, <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>'s Mindset has shifted toward the Principled...)
e891fb12-df86-47a4-bef6-8bfe69791e60/Eve.cn: “莫急，莫急，你且听我一言，<NL>可当真要做这世间的仁人义士么……”<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>说起世间仁人义士之事，将自己种种所见，细细讲述……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（听取<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>讲述市井百态，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的处世立场已向刚正转变……）

7bdb8f2a-b013-41f6-83da-e54d05b836c8/Eve.en: "Oh? You've come Veil Scar Sect not to hire killers or have us steal treasures for you?<NL>Honestly, all we know are a few underhanded tricks. Hehe, it's quite surprising that our skills could gain favor with <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
7bdb8f2a-b013-41f6-83da-e54d05b836c8/Eve.cn: “哦？你到我界青门中，既不是来买凶杀人，也不想托我帮你窃物栽赃？<NL>说来惭愧，我界青门只会一些雕虫小技，嘿嘿……也不知能不能入得了<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>的法眼……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

be7f05c5-2eec-42e5-a656-a0389f206f27/Eve.en: "I'm afraid <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> might violate our rules to inflict harm instead of helping others, so I dare not impart these martial arts to you at this moment.<NL>Once <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> demonstrates true righteousness, we won't turn you away..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be negative...)</color>
be7f05c5-2eec-42e5-a656-a0389f206f27/Eve.cn: “只恐<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>不去医人，反去害人，因此实不敢授以武学……<NL><color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>何时能自证善道，再来请教，我辈必不推辞……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为负……）</color>

55b87a0c-5ecc-494c-a202-690561da8cd3/Eve.en: Then, an apprentice herbalist from the Kongsang Sect brought forth a bowl of medicinal soup...<NL><NL>"The flavor of this elixir is intensely acrid and bitter.<NL>For the sake of longevity, try your best not to regurgitate it and drink it all..."<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> says as they pours the elixir from a bowl into <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>'s mouth...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After taking the Kongsang Sect's secret elixir, <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>'s lifespan has been extended by three years...)</color>
55b87a0c-5ecc-494c-a202-690561da8cd3/Eve.cn: 随后，空桑派的药仆便端来一碗药汤……<NL><NL>“此药入口极腥极苦，<NL>为得延寿，你可要好生忍着，尽数饮下……”<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>一边说，一边将黢黑的药汤灌入了<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>口中……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> （因服食了空桑秘药，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>得以延寿三年……） </color>

dd5879ae-4463-407a-af92-081cd4553ec7/Eve.en: "<color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> symbolizes righteousness and honor, so why would you seek to acquire the petty tricks of our Veil Scar Sect?<NL>Should others come to know of it, it won't benefit either of us."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be positive...)</color>
dd5879ae-4463-407a-af92-081cd4553ec7/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>正大光明，何必学我界青门这些微末伎俩……<NL>若是被他人瞧去，于你于我都不算好事……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为正……）</color>

040a84b1-738c-4820-8efe-a85e58358e13/Eve.en: "It is said that in times of great disorder, if one cannot be a benevolent Xiake, then self-preservation becomes the only path..."
040a84b1-738c-4820-8efe-a85e58358e13/Eve.cn: “有道是天下大乱，做不得仁人义士，便只能独善吾身……”
040a84b1-738c-4820-8efe-a85e58358e13/Eve.ru: "Говорят, что во времена великого беспорядка, если человек не может быть доброжелательным Сяке, то самосохранение становится единственным путем..."

27e1ff7c-ea55-4b4e-805f-631b1c60710c/Eve.en: "The Fuloong Sanctuary's martial arts aren't for just anyone.<NL><color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> often hangs around those self-proclaimed do-gooders and might not grasp the divine might of True Loong. How then could I impart our sacred arts to you?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be positive...)</color>
27e1ff7c-ea55-4b4e-805f-631b1c60710c/Eve.cn: “我伏龙坛的神功并非凡人可学！<NL><color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>常与‘正道’为伍，必不能诚心信奉真龙神威，我坛神功又怎能传授于你？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为正……）</color>

2ada8065-3997-4aa8-a168-b201653480a4/Eve.en: "You are indeed wise, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>! Understanding the exposition of the dharma of our Vajra Sect is the ultimate path in this world.<NL>Since you have decided to join us, with the support of the Dharma Kings, you'll be free from the threats of <color=#yellow>Xiangshu</color>."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they've provided Sect Support!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
2ada8065-3997-4aa8-a168-b201653480a4/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>果然智慧！识得我金刚宗的法门才是这世间的无上大法！<NL>你即愿投入我金刚宗座下，有我诸天法王护持，那区区<color=#yellow>「相枢」</color>又何足惧哉？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

0a38ae08-95e3-45c7-94fe-a547b44c1f5c/Eve.en: "The Fuloong Sanctuary's servants are known for their wisdom and capability, and they're unwavering in their loyalty.<NL>How about I gift one to you, to serve at your command?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Request Fuloong Sanctuary to provide <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a loyal servant to become Taiwu's companion...)</color>
0a38ae08-95e3-45c7-94fe-a547b44c1f5c/Eve.cn: “我龙岛的忠仆自然是精明强干，忠心不二！<NL>我这便赠你一名，供你驱策如何？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（请求伏龙坛将忠仆赐予<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>成为太吾的同道……）</color>

f44b5f36-f42b-444f-b508-c83aa6c79ea8/Eve.en: "Excellent! As the saying goes, 'To do a good job, one must first sharpen their tools.' We of the Swordsmith Villa are ready to be your most prized blade, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>.<NL>We hope you'll make the most of our craftsmanship and bring honor to our sect!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
f44b5f36-f42b-444f-b508-c83aa6c79ea8/Eve.cn: “好好好！正所谓‘工欲善其事，必先利其器’，我铸剑山庄愿做你<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>手中之‘宝剑’！<NL>愿你莫要辜负了我派前人的心血，令我派的绝艺可以扬名于天下！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

67301907-f740-4b20-9571-bc7ac429ba64/Eve.en: "Amitabha... Buddhists adhere to our stringent rules. We cannot accept women as disciples.<NL>I hope you can appreciate our principles, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Only men are allowed to learn Shaolin Sect martial arts...)</color>
67301907-f740-4b20-9571-bc7ac429ba64/Eve.cn: “阿弥陀佛……佛门之地，早有清规，不可收受女子为弟子……<NL>还望<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>见谅……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（少林派只向男子传授功法……）</color>
67301907-f740-4b20-9571-bc7ac429ba64/Eve.ru: "Амитабха... Буддисты придерживаются наших строгих правил. Мы не можем принимать женщин в качестве учеников.<NL>Я надеюсь, вы сможете оценить наши принципы, <color=#yellow>Тайу</color>."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Только мужчинам разрешается изучать Боевые искусства Секты Шаолинь...)</color>

9b3c30f5-231c-42d8-9e7c-ed4926211148/Eve.en: "There's no need for further words. Just give me a name..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(By providing a name, you can enlist the Veil Scar Sect for an assassination.)<NL>(At any given time, you can only assign an assassination against one target.)</color>
9b3c30f5-231c-42d8-9e7c-ed4926211148/Eve.cn: “……多的便不用说了……只要告诉我那人姓甚名谁……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（通过告知姓名，委托界青门对某人进行暗杀……）<NL>（同一时间，只能委托暗杀一人……）</color>
9b3c30f5-231c-42d8-9e7c-ed4926211148/Eve.ru: - В дальнейших словах нет необходимости. Просто назови мне имя..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Указав имя, вы можете завербовать Секту Завесы для совершения убийства.)<NL>(В любой момент времени вы можете назначить убийство только для одной цели.)</color>

3376f6d2-2e30-47a7-9eb3-43a5ca5983e2/Eve.en: "The Art of Astral Coordination requires elders of our sect with Qi Arts of great Pure Essence to perform.<NL>It helps you channel the spiritual tides, uniting spirit and surroundings, making your Qi Arts easier to use.<NL>In the blink of an eye, you can complete several Microcosmic Circulations..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(With the aid of the Art of Astral Coordination, instantly complete the Microcosmic Circulation of the selected Qi Arts...)</color>
3376f6d2-2e30-47a7-9eb3-43a5ca5983e2/Eve.cn: “这七星调元之术，需由我派内功精纯的长老发功施行，<NL>此法能助你吐纳灵潮，神与境合，运转内功事半功倍，<NL>转眼之间，便能完成数次周天运转……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> （借助七星调元之术，转瞬完成所选内功的数次周天运转……）</color>

6915999a-b74f-4f93-8d4e-e17ac5f93215/Eve.en: "The Han people see the Five Immortals Sect as cultists. Yet, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> wishes to acquire martial skills from us?<NL>Alright, we Miao people have no great skills, save for some 'underhanded tricks.' Go ahead if you want to learn."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
6915999a-b74f-4f93-8d4e-e17ac5f93215/Eve.cn: “汉人视我五仙教如同毒蛇猛兽，想不到<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>竟要向我们讨教武功？<NL>好吧好吧，我们苗人也没什么本事，不过会种种树，捉捉虫，你要学便学吧！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

e443bbc6-6669-4ad2-8fdb-0b79c12b17d2/Eve.en: "Well done... well done...<NL>The sound of the sutra chant fills the air... thus have I heard...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> (Because <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/> is meditating in the Sutra Pavilion, repenting and reflecting, people's views of <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/> have slightly changed...) </color>"
e443bbc6-6669-4ad2-8fdb-0b79c12b17d2/Eve.cn: “善哉……善哉……<NL>梵呗圆音……如是我闻……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>  （因为<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>在藏经阁中面壁阅经，忏悔改过，世人对<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的看法有了些许变化……）</color>

0dc5ad3c-9dea-4e2c-a1dd-15e978785b64/Eve.en: "Amitabha... If <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> chooses the righteous path, we will be willing to impart our martial arts.<NL>However, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>'s reputation leaves us uncertain."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be negative...)</color>
0dc5ad3c-9dea-4e2c-a1dd-15e978785b64/Eve.cn: “阿弥陀佛……若<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>一念向善，我少林自当将武学倾囊相授，<NL>只是……<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>之善恶，我派未敢轻信……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为负……）</color>

2dcdd465-72cc-4379-95c9-bb3644f245d8/Eve.en: "Free from thoughts and desires, all things are at peace..."<NL>As the enforcers of Yuanshan Sect chanted their scriptures, <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/> gradually entered a deep state of meditation, feeling Xiangshu's malevolent thoughts gradually dissipate...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Stone Cell Contemplation results in a decrease in <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>'s level of Mania and Possession...)</color>
2dcdd465-72cc-4379-95c9-bb3644f245d8/Eve.cn: “无念无欲，身如石壁，无想无求，万事皆休……”<NL>随着元山派众护法念起经诀，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>渐渐入定，感觉相枢的邪念也渐渐离去……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（通过在石牢静坐，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的入邪、化魔程度降低了……）</color>

d477ee4f-12df-45de-bce2-16e027907a49/Eve.en: "<color=#yellow>Xiangshu</color>'s malevolent thoughts can penetrate the mind. Fortunately, the Yuanshan Sect has the stone cell, a place where people can exorcise their inner demons..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Meditation in the stone prison results in a decrease in the levels of Mania and Possession...)</color>
d477ee4f-12df-45de-bce2-16e027907a49/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「相枢」</color>的邪念无孔不入，幸好我元山修有石牢，可助人摈弃欲念，消除心魔……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（在石牢中静坐减少人物入邪、化魔的程度……）</color>

c2bf25db-5b4a-4456-8318-28f9ac51a01f/Eve.en: "Of course, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>, as you pledge to rid the world of Xiangshu, we, being simple folks, eagerly offer whatever humble assistance we can.<NL>We wish that <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> will uphold the martial essence of Emei and elevate them to glory."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they've provided Sect Support!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
c2bf25db-5b4a-4456-8318-28f9ac51a01f/Eve.cn: “这个自然，<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>誓言灭除相枢，我辈虽为凡夫俗子，却也极是盼望略尽绵力……<NL>还望<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>能将我峨眉武学去粕归真，发扬光大……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

0202954d-6f9e-43ae-ac51-0e052e5b2330/Eve.en: "In this day and age, all sorts of strange things happen. Truly, it takes all kinds to make a world!<NL>I have seen so much that nothing surprises me anymore..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Listen to <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s account of the mundane world to change the Mindset of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> or of a designated companion...)</color>
0202954d-6f9e-43ae-ac51-0e052e5b2330/Eve.cn: “如今这世道，奇事纷纷，可当真是什么样的人都有！<NL>我这俗眼看来看去，早已见怪不怪……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（听取<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>讲述市井百态，改变<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>或指定同道的处世立场……）</color>

61848793-7ff1-40d2-97a9-296c8a420ee7/Eve.en: "It's regrettable that we should have been dedicated to aiding <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> in eradicating Xiangshu.<NL>However, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>'s reputation leaves us uncertain."<NL><NL>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be negative...)
61848793-7ff1-40d2-97a9-296c8a420ee7/Eve.cn: “可惜……我辈本应为<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>灭除相枢略尽绵力，<NL>然而<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>声名如此，实令我辈心中存疑……”<NL><NL>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为负……）

It's a piece of cake!<NL>The Lion-Face Clan wields great influence, and no one would dare to disrespect us."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Request the Lion-Face Clan to spread Taiwu's reputation and earn <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> plenty of Prestige...)</color>
28f72f85-445c-4d2a-bfe9-d94ed5782ce7/Eve.cn: “想要我狮相门助你扬威？这个简单！<NL>我狮相门一呼百应，谁敢不给我狮相门面子！？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（请狮相门以各种手段散播太吾的威名，使<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得大量威望……）</color>

350a99f0-8b17-474f-a310-3c1f3c8a2115/Eve.en: "I didn't expect you to be so bold!<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> (<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/> underwent the Five Venoms Ablution, cleansing their body of toxins and Gu...) </color>"
350a99f0-8b17-474f-a310-3c1f3c8a2115/Eve.cn: “想不到，你倒挺有胆量！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>通过五圣秘浴，其体内的毒素和蛊虫均受到了驱除……）</color>

abe6414e-1a2f-491c-b381-a4ca103046b0/Eve.cn: “不得了！不得了！<NL>你得了秘法神威，日后若是得见「相枢」大神，可得为我教美言几句……”<NL>随后，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>便在血犼教众护法的拥簇下，走入血池……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因血池秘法，在接下来的一年，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>所有功法的威力都有所提升……）  </color>

bdf4c491-3c57-4a06-b451-eaebc665f67d/Eve.cn: “世人愚昧，修行无门，<NL>你若能进奉足量银钱，我等自然不吝助你一臂之力，<NL>这当真是：‘我不入地狱，谁入地狱？’的大慈悲啊……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>  （进奉大量银钱，使得一项主要属性在接下来的一年得到提升……）</color>

b803265b-6a40-4a52-ae1d-99d3f0629855/Eve.cn: “仙人抚琴声入梦，玉镜落影一念中……你屏息再看……”<NL><Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>依<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>所说，屏息往一明珏玉镜中望去，<NL>只见一位仙人周身彩雾缭绕，手抚水晶瑶琴，端坐玉台之上……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因为看到仙人抚琴，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的某项负面特性被减弱了……）</color>

9c34bf18-49cd-43f6-9d44-c19b985e5c28/Eve.en: "If <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> is truly committed to eradicating evil, our sect won't stand idly by.<NL>But <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>'s reputation is not up to par. 9c34bf18-49cd-43f6-9d44-c19b985e5c28/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>若当真立誓除妖灭怪，我派岂有不助之理？<NL>然而<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>声名如此，我武当派不可助纣为虐，自毁侠义之道……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为负……）</color>

I shouldn't grant this...<NL>But we must honor our ancestors' decrees and the steles in Taiwu Village.<NL>Very well, aside from alchemy, you can explore some of our other martial arts."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
14fa783e-e3a1-4004-b391-b272d2b1c26a/Eve.cn: “我空桑派向来不问世事，你非我派中人，我原不可应允……<NL>只是前人遗令，又有太吾村中石碑作誓……好吧！<NL>除了炼丹之术，我派的其它功法你便慢慢琢磨吧……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

1501fd02-9268-4c05-81ca-8f84ed8dea9d/Eve.cn: “仙人舞剑影惝恍，云衣飘飘化浮光……你屏息再看……”<NL><Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>依<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>所说，屏息往一明珏玉镜中望去，<NL>只见一位仙人周身彩雾缭绕，手持水晶长剑，跃于玉台之上……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因为看到仙人舞剑，<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的某项正面特性被加强了……）</color>

93ff82fd-871e-47e2-8c7b-5cb5537ea0ea/Eve.en: "<color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>, if your true purpose is to eliminate Xiangshu, we cannot impart our sect's mystical arts to you, which stem from the mighty <color=#yellow>Xiangshu</color>."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Reputation must not be positive...)</color>
93ff82fd-871e-47e2-8c7b-5cb5537ea0ea/Eve.cn: “<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>誓言灭除相枢，我教奇术乃是<color=#yellow>「相枢」</color>大神真传，万万不可教你知晓……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为正……）</color>
93ff82fd-871e-47e2-8c7b-5cb5537ea0ea/Eve.ru: "<color=#yellow>Тайу</color>, если ваша истинная цель - уничтожить Сяншу, мы не можем передать вам мистические искусства нашей Секты, которые происходят от могущественного <color=#yellow>Сяншу</color>."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />Репутация не должна быть положительной...)</color>

7ea6bfd7-f94d-4dfc-b3c4-dd12e7995d5c/Eve.en: "For the initial needle, I'll need to target the Baihui Acupoint, so be prepared for some discomfort..."<NL>After a thorough treatment, a soothing blend of cold and warmth flows through <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>'s meridians, revitalizing their entire body...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(All injuries on <Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/> have been completely healed...)</color>
7ea6bfd7-f94d-4dfc-b3c4-dd12e7995d5c/Eve.cn: “这第一针，需下在百会穴，你可得忍住疼痛……”<NL>一番诊治过后，数道时而清冽，时而温暖的气流缓缓流遍<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>的奇经八脉，四肢百骸……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=SpirtualCharacterId str=Name/>身上所有的伤势均被治愈了……）</color>

1b70d5ed-130d-4260-a57c-57be1654b514/Eve.en: "The sea of suffering is boundless, but turning back leads to salvation... Lay down your weapons and find peace...<NL>Those who meditate on the scriptures must abandon their desires for fame and fortune to truly change their ways...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> (By spending Prestige, you can meditate on the scriptures under the guidance of Shaolin monks, repent, and reduce the duration of selected Reputation effects...) </color>"
1b70d5ed-130d-4260-a57c-57be1654b514/Eve.cn: “苦海无涯，回头是岸……放下屠刀，立地成佛……<NL>凡面壁阅经者，唯有抛却名利之欲，方能改行自新……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> （消耗威望，在少林僧人的主持下面壁阅经，忏悔改过，能够减轻所选名誉的作用时间……）</color>

e2b8aacf-4ac3-413e-b868-7c11d0072f61/Eve.en: "Amitabha... if <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color> is truly committed to righteousness, we will share our martial wisdom.<NL>However, <color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>'s reputation raises concerns.<NL>Additionally, our monastic rules prevent us from accepting female disciples. e2b8aacf-4ac3-413e-b868-7c11d0072f61/Eve.cn: “阿弥陀佛……若<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>一念向善，我少林自当将武学倾囊相授，<NL>只是……<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>之善恶，我派未敢轻信……<NL>且佛门之地，早有清规，不可收受女子为弟子……还望<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>见谅……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（少林派只向男子传授功法……）<NL>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的名誉不可为负……）</color>

ad4eca95-bdba-4c84-9a29-9ff199824b39/Eve.en: "<color=#yellow>Taiwu</color>, if you wish to acquire our divine techniques at Fuloong Sanctuary, it's quite simple.<NL>When you encounter someone from Chiming Island with the 'Long' or 'Situ' surname, just address them as 'Lord.'"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You obtained sect training permission from <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>...)<NL>(It seems you've gained the support of some <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples, and they're backing you!)<NL>(After learning <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s martial arts, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can trade Prestige for Martial Arts Books with <Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/> disciples...)</color>
ad4eca95-bdba-4c84-9a29-9ff199824b39/Eve.cn: “你既是<color=#yellow>「太吾」</color>，想要学我伏龙坛的神功，倒也不难！<NL>只要今后见到我赤明岛姓‘龙’、姓‘司徒’的，恭恭敬敬的称一声‘主上’便可！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（取得了<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的学艺许可……）<NL>（似乎获得了一部分<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子的支持！从这些弟子处取得了门派支持！）<NL>（当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />习得<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>的功法后，就可以通过花费‘威望’与<Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>弟子交换相应的功法藏书……）</color>

5e46c2bc-0ccc-4188-9f8b-37885c4492e7/Eve.en: "Indeed, the Valley of Flowers is renowned for our exceptional medical art. With my needle, no one will succumb to illness."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Healing all of the character's injuries...)</color>
5e46c2bc-0ccc-4188-9f8b-37885c4492e7/Eve.cn: “不错，我百花谷医术通神，在我神针之下，绝无死于非命之人……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（治愈人物身上所有的伤势……）</color>
5e46c2bc-0ccc-4188-9f8b-37885c4492e7/Eve.ru: "Действительно, Долина цветов славится нашим исключительным медицинским искусством. С моей иглой никто не заболеет".<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Исцеление всех травм персонажа...)</color>

f26567eb-d6e6-40d5-8e28-7ad3c3f117f6/Eve.cn: “你问这五圣秘浴有何妙用？所谓五圣秘浴，<NL>就是跟金蛇、赤蝎、玉蟾、碧蜈、青蛛这五圣共浴一池……<NL>若非有功于本教之人，可无缘见识！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（与五圣共浴，可驱除人物体内的所有毒素，<NL>并杀死人物体内至多三只蛊虫，同时减少王蛊存活的时间……）</color>

Я уже отправил сообщение в гильдии Торговцев.<NL>Скоро они соберутся здесь, и состоится ярмарка..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<ArgBox key=AdventureName type=string/> теперь начнем с <Character key=CharacterId str=CurBlock/>...)</color>

2f6424dd-d414-4e09-98b1-20278b50095d/Eve.en: "Although I wish to gather supplies and secure peace for the people, this is indeed a costly and labor-intensive task.<NL>If you are willing to lend a hand with a donation, I shall never forget your generosity..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Donating resources will increase <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s Regional Favor in this region.)</color>
2f6424dd-d414-4e09-98b1-20278b50095d/Eve.cn: “我虽想筹集物资，安境保民，然而此事却实在费财劳力，<NL>若你愿意施以援手，捐赠些许资源，我必不会忘怀你的恩情……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（捐赠资源，提升<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>在此地的地区恩义……）</color>

bf3398d2-de85-43e4-bb38-9a5d45d87e39/Eve.en: "With your donation of <Resource key=ResourceType str=Name/>, prosperity for this place is within reach.<NL>This kindness, I shall never forget!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has donated <Resource key=ResourceType str=Name/>, gaining Regional Favor in the <ArgBox key=AreaDebtGain type=int/><Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/> Region...)</color>
bf3398d2-de85-43e4-bb38-9a5d45d87e39/Eve.cn: “有你今日捐赠的<Resource key=ResourceType str=Name/>，此地兴旺指日可待，<NL>这番恩德，我没齿难忘！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>捐赠了<Resource key=ResourceType str=Name/>，获得了<ArgBox key=AreaDebtGain type=int/><Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>地区恩义……）</color>

bdbe4af7-2c70-4a6d-9d90-875063abba0f/Eve.en: "So it was this person...<NL>I understand now, how should I mediate for you from here on?"
bdbe4af7-2c70-4a6d-9d90-875063abba0f/Eve.cn: “原来是此人……<NL>我已知晓，此后当如何为你斡旋？”
bdbe4af7-2c70-4a6d-9d90-875063abba0f/Eve.ru: "Итак, это был этот человек...<NL>Теперь я понимаю, как я должен выступать посредником для вас с этого момента?"

095460de-a233-4312-b4c2-d938efb3691c/Eve.en: "I understand...<NL>Wait here a moment, I shall go and put in a good word for you."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Thanks to <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s mediation, <Character key=SelectedCharId str=Name/>'s Favorability for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has increased...)</color>
095460de-a233-4312-b4c2-d938efb3691c/Eve.cn: “我明白了……<NL>你且稍待，我这便前去为你美言几句……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因为<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>的斡旋，<Character key=SelectedCharId str=Name/>对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的好感上升了……）</color>
095460de-a233-4312-b4c2-d938efb3691c/Eve.ru: - Я понимаю...<NL>Подождите здесь минутку, я пойду и замолвлю за вас словечко."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Благодаря <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>посредничество, <Character key=SelectedCharId str=Name/>Благосклонность к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> увеличилось...)</color>

195b4d1f-37c4-4fe0-ad48-35879f5f6465/Eve.en: "Is there something you find difficult to speak about?<NL>Alright, let me handle this matter for you.<NL>But I wonder, who is it that has caused you such concern?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Spending Prestige can increase or decrease <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s Favorability...)</color>
195b4d1f-37c4-4fe0-ad48-35879f5f6465/Eve.cn: “你心中有话难言？<NL>也罢，此事便由我来为你斡旋。<NL>只是不知究竟是何人，引得你如此心忧……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（消耗威望，能够提升或者降低人物对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的好感……）</color>
195b4d1f-37c4-4fe0-ad48-35879f5f6465/Eve.ru: "Есть ли что-то, о чем вам трудно говорить?<NL>Хорошо, позволь мне уладить это дело за тебя.<NL>Но мне интересно, кто же это вызвал у вас такое беспокойство?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Престиж расходов может увеличиваться или уменьшаться <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>его Благосклонность...)</color>

14c98725-bea0-4cd1-a97c-4b99da055bc6/Eve.en: "Money makes the world go around.<NL>As long as the Silver is sufficient, with a bit of manpower, there is nothing that can't be done..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Spend Silver to send manpower from the rich will increase or decrease local Culture or Stability...)</color>
14c98725-bea0-4cd1-a97c-4b99da055bc6/Eve.cn: “有钱能使鬼推磨，<NL>只要银钱足够，派些人手，再没有办不成的事……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（花费银钱，令富豪派出人手，提高或降低当地的文化或安定……）</color>
14c98725-bea0-4cd1-a97c-4b99da055bc6/Eve.ru: "Деньги заставляют мир вращаться.<NL>Пока серебра достаточно, с небольшим количеством рабочей силы, нет ничего, чего нельзя было бы сделать..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Тратя серебро на отправку рабочей силы из богатых стран, вы увеличите или уменьшите местную культуру или стабильность ...)</color>

c4c7e15b-b36b-4304-95b8-77dc6a5eb86e/Eve.en: "Well...in this way...<NL>As you have advised, I have dispatched people to maintain the stability of this region..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>'s Stability has increased...)</color>
c4c7e15b-b36b-4304-95b8-77dc6a5eb86e/Eve.cn: “如此……这般……<NL>我已依你所言，派出人手维护此地安定……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>的安定得到了提升……）</color>
c4c7e15b-b36b-4304-95b8-77dc6a5eb86e/Eve.ru: "Well...in сюда...<NL>Как вы и советовали, я отправил людей для поддержания стабильности в этом регионе..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>Стабильность системы возросла...)</color>

625042c7-3ed9-4cfa-b9cb-af7a22698304/Eve.en: "I have always loved poetry and painting, finding beauty in the moon and wit in the flowers.<NL>If you have seen my poems and paintings, surely you must have been moved in many ways..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Spending Prestige can change <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> or a companion's mood...)</color>
625042c7-3ed9-4cfa-b9cb-af7a22698304/Eve.cn: “我素爱意到笔随，咏月嘲花，<NL>你若是见了我的诗画，想必也能生出许多感触……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（消耗威望，改变<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>或是同道的心情……）</color>

853a7d21-06ec-48f0-be53-093aca51ec59/Eve.en: "Prepare to witness the artistry that breathes life into every stroke..."
853a7d21-06ec-48f0-be53-093aca51ec59/Eve.cn: “便叫你见识一番，何为笔底春风……”
853a7d21-06ec-48f0-be53-093aca51ec59/Eve.ru: "Приготовьтесь стать свидетелями мастерства, которое вдыхает жизнь в каждый штрих..."

853a7d21-06ec-48f0-be53-093aca51ec59/Opt.en: (Compose a poem in a state of joyful enlightenment...)
(Appreciate a painting in a state of tranquil solitude...)

8b7dce7b-06cb-4007-9692-dffed75012bb/Eve.en: "I've gained inspiration..."<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> thought of something joyful, and composed a poem in an instant.<NL>Every word and every line, a work of true genius, was a delight to read...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=SelectedCharId str=Name/>'s mood has improved...)</color>
8b7dce7b-06cb-4007-9692-dffed75012bb/Eve.cn: “我已得了灵感……”<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>思及喜悦之事，转眼赋诗一首，<NL>字字句句，果真是妙手偶得，读来令人畅快舒怀……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=SelectedCharId str=Name/>的心情上升了……）</color>

008cdbd4-e779-441c-966a-7203be9fbf80/Eve.en: "You want me to draft a letter to a Merchant Guild to strengthen Taiwu's ties with them? With the 'Favor' you have here, it's certainly no big deal. However, I need to know<NL>where you'd like me to send the letter."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Spending Regional Favor from <Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>'s affiliated Region to increase Favorability with the chosen Merchant Guild...)</color>
008cdbd4-e779-441c-966a-7203be9fbf80/Eve.cn: “想要我修书一封寄与商会，增进「太吾」与其的好感？凭你与此地的‘恩义’，此事自然不难，却不知你想要我寄信至何<NL>处？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（消耗<Character key=CharacterId str=AreaName/>的地区恩义增加与所选商会的好感……）</color>

47b91aa8-dbfa-4817-9349-77b3f2e7c311/Eve.en: "Here... With this... Done! The letter has been sent!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Favorability of the receiving guild toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has increased...)</color>
47b91aa8-dbfa-4817-9349-77b3f2e7c311/Eve.cn: “如此……这般……好啦！书信已经送出！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（收到书信的商会对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的好感上升了……）</color>
47b91aa8-dbfa-4817-9349-77b3f2e7c311/Eve.ru: - Вот... С этим... Сделано! Письмо отправлено!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Благосклонность принимающей Гильдии к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> увеличилось...)</color>

390c9651-d88c-46a0-ad18-8ea3198ddec5/Eve.en: "As with raising a child, so with the land: 'three years of fallow, three years of harvest'...<NL>The art of agriculture is a deep discipline indeed..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Managing the land restores a portion of the resources on some local tiles...)</color>
390c9651-d88c-46a0-ad18-8ea3198ddec5/Eve.cn: “养地如养娃，所谓‘饿三年，肥三年’……<NL>这农桑之事，也是一门学问……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（调理土地，恢复当地部分地格的部分资源量……）</color>
390c9651-d88c-46a0-ad18-8ea3198ddec5/Eve.ru: "Как с воспитанием ребенка, так и с землей: "три года под паром, три года урожая"...<NL>Искусство ведения сельского хозяйства - действительно глубокая дисциплина..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Управление землей восстанавливает часть Ресурсов на некоторых местных плитках ...)</color>

cea8de6d-5062-4fe1-b123-ee229cd7e482/Eve.en: "The energy of the land must be alive for the seedlings to flourish; if the energy is stagnant, the crops will be foul."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s regulation, the resource quantity of some tiles has been slightly restored.)</color>
cea8de6d-5062-4fe1-b123-ee229cd7e482/Eve.cn: “地气活了，苗子才壮；地气浊了，稻子都带腥……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（经过<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>的调理，此地部分地格的资源量得到了些许恢复……）</color>
cea8de6d-5062-4fe1-b123-ee229cd7e482/Eve.ru: "Энергия земли должна быть живой, чтобы всходы могли цвести; если Энергия застаивается, урожай будет плохим".<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(После <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>согласно регламенту, количество Ресурсов некоторых плиток было незначительно восстановлено.)</color>

6c5c230b-990d-4d35-9c83-7a59eab2f832/Eve.en: "Beyond the letter of the law, there is still room for humanity.<NL>Yet, I wonder what are your views on our current regional regulations?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Choose a provincial regulation and modify its punishment intensity, lasting for 3 years...)</color>
6c5c230b-990d-4d35-9c83-7a59eab2f832/Eve.cn: “理法之外，尚能容几分人情，<NL>却不知你对我地当前法规，有何见地？”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（选择一条州域法规，修改其惩罚力度，持续3年……）</color>
6c5c230b-990d-4d35-9c83-7a59eab2f832/Eve.ru: "Помимо буквы закона, все еще есть место для человечности.<NL>И все же, мне интересно, каково ваше мнение о наших нынешних региональных правилах?"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Выберите постановление провинции и измените его интенсивность наказания сроком на 3 года...)</color>

163638f0-718f-4289-8602-e4b01b08e9a8/Eve.en: "This profound principle is also recorded in the Wang Chan's Scriptures,<NL>I believe you must now have had a moment of enlightenment..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After consulting the Wang Chan's Scriptures, one insight leads to thousands of realizations.<NL>In the blink of an eye, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has studied <Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/> <ArgBox key=SelectCountResult type=int/> times...)</color>
163638f0-718f-4289-8602-e4b01b08e9a8/Eve.cn: “此篇妙理，于王禅典籍之中亦有记载，<NL>想必如今你已豁然开悟……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> （因参阅王禅典籍，一闻千悟，<NL>转眼之间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已将<Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/>研读<ArgBox key=SelectCountResult type=int/>次……）</color>

Just disassemble the usable parts, and I can craft a new one from them!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Exchange 3 identical tools for 1 new tool of the same type with full durability...)</color>
482533f4-b0b1-4353-8e1c-3b175464a84d/Eve.cn: “你要是有使不得的旧工具，<NL>尽可拿到我这儿来，只需将可用的部位拆解一二，便能再制成一个新的！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（以3个同名工具，换取1个耐久值为满的同名工具……）</color>
482533f4-b0b1-4353-8e1c-3b175464a84d/Eve.ru: "Если у вас есть старые инструменты, которые нельзя использовать,<NL>не стесняйтесь приносить их мне. Просто разберите пригодные для использования детали, и я смогу изготовить из них новую!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Замените 3 идентичных инструмента на 1 новый инструмент того же типа с полной Прочностью...)</color>

8150dde3-ca56-47cd-82ad-70113e47ebd4/Eve.en: "Say no more! Please wait a moment...<NL>Out with the old, in with the new. Now, take this newly crafted item!"
8150dde3-ca56-47cd-82ad-70113e47ebd4/Eve.cn: “好说，好说！你且稍待片刻……<NL>旧的不去，新的不来，这新制成的物什你便收下吧！”
8150dde3-ca56-47cd-82ad-70113e47ebd4/Eve.ru: - Ни слова больше! Пожалуйста, подождите минутку...<NL>Покончи со старым, займись новым. А теперь возьми этот недавно созданный предмет!"

c6cee7ac-eabe-4e95-a922-a9e84ad937c3/Eve.en: "To begin the harmonization of essence, one must calm the mind, settle the thoughts, and ensure inner peace."
c6cee7ac-eabe-4e95-a922-a9e84ad937c3/Eve.cn: “待调元开始，须得宁神静气，心平意定……”
c6cee7ac-eabe-4e95-a922-a9e84ad937c3/Eve.ru: "Чтобы начать гармонизацию сущности, нужно успокоить ум, привести в порядок мысли и обеспечить внутренний покой".

863322ff-e88b-4016-ad3b-a516c9accec2/Eve.en: "Like this...<NL>Using the Astral Coordination, naturally, it will help the energy flow smoothly, and the Tao can be achieved..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(With the help of the Wudang Elder,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has performed the Astral Coordination, completing <ArgBox key=SelectCountResult type=int/> cycles of the Microcosmic Circulation...)</color>
863322ff-e88b-4016-ad3b-a516c9accec2/Eve.cn: “如此……这般……<NL>借助着七星调元之术，自然协灵通气，道可得矣……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey> （得武当长老相助施行七星调元之术，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已完成<ArgBox key=SelectCountResult type=int/>次周天运转……）</color>

f3e82505-1c88-422f-bc09-176f9e148e9d/Eve.en: "Thank you, thank you, please come again."

f011c501-fa48-42ac-82ca-42c953f5e442/Eve.en: "Very good...<NL>But there are countless methods of cultivation. Which one should we teach you?"
